item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01130","case1_error":"Reports unsupported total 120 without calculating Michael’s or Joyce’s durations or summing all four; correct total is 76.","case2_error":"Subtracts the unearned $25 gift from the correctly calculated $46 balance.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final total; the second explicitly introduces an invalid deduction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01131","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 80 − 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 180 − 45 − 45 − 20 as 90 instead of 70.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate correctly specified expressions.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01132","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage, then divides by coverage, incorrectly obtaining 1200 gallons instead of 3.","case2_error":"Treats one student’s 105 pens as the entire pool, omitting multiplication by three.","reason":"The first misuses the coverage conversion; the second confuses an individual allocation with the pooled total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01133","case1_error":"Evaluates 18 months plus 6 years as 8.5 years instead of 7.5 years.","case2_error":"Treats 300 cherries per two hours as 300 per hour and additionally assumes three syrup-making hours per quart.","reason":"The first incorrectly evaluates a valid duration expression; the second constructs incorrect rate and time relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01134","case1_error":"Uses 12 cups per set instead of 24, omitting the two-dozen factor.","case2_error":"After correctly specifying (3 × 12)/2, introduces an unjustified multiplication and gives conflicting final amounts 18 and 9.","reason":"The first omits a stated quantity factor; the second adds an invalid operation after the correct share formula, with no calculation supporting 9.","judgment":"different"}]}
